title: Terms and Conditions
intro: This document represents a binding agreement between the user and the Ters application, and governs the use of services available through the app.

items.text: Ters provides the following services:
On-site electronic vehicle inspection.
Comprehensive vehicle maintenance.
Body repair and painting services.
On-site electronic inspection fee: 150 SAR.
Inspection and transport fee for maintenance or bodywork: 250 SAR.
Additional fee for hydraulic tow truck when required: 100 SAR.
The customer may request a refund only before execution begins.
Service is considered started when:
The technician heads to the customer’s location.
The tow truck is dispatched toward the customer’s location.
After execution begins, cancellation or refunds are not allowed.
After inspection or vehicle intake, the app provides a technical report including:
Detected issues.
Repair costs.
Spare parts costs.
The customer has two options:
Approve and pay.
Reject the report and cancel.
Before selecting (Approve and pay), the customer may modify certain items in the report, such as removing specific repair items. After editing, they can proceed with approval and payment.
A one-month warranty applies only to repaired parts, starting from the vehicle delivery date.
The warranty does not cover issues not repaired or not approved in the report.
The warranty does not cover misuse, accidents, or third-party maintenance after repair.
All personal belongings must be removed before vehicle handover, and the app is not responsible for any lost items inside the vehicle.
Ters reserves the right to refuse or suspend service before execution if service delivery is not possible for any reason.
Using the application constitutes full acceptance of all terms and conditions in this document.
